name: dw0-s3lr
setup: set -e; python3 -m venv /opt/p2venv; /opt/p2venv/bin/pip install -q torch==2.7.0 numpy tokenizers==0.21.1 transformers==4.51.3 safetensors matplotlib pytest; /opt/p2venv/bin/python -m babylm.data.prepare --download --splits train_10M,dev; /opt/p2venv/bin/python -m pytest -q -x babylm/tests --deselect babylm/tests/test_a4.py::test_make_a4_t2_jobs; if [ -n "${RESTORE_URI:-}" ]; then mkdir -p babylm/runs; gsutil -m -q rsync -r "$RESTORE_URI" babylm/runs; fi; T=/opt/babylm/ruler_tools_c09ef37ac16bbe0a9f3ab9def66ad000ea40cef5; mkdir -p $T; gsutil -q cp "$RULER_TOOLS_URI" /tmp/rt.tgz; tar -xzf /tmp/rt.tgz -C $T; $T/babylm/eval/setup.sh /opt/babylm; gsutil -q cp __BUCKET__/code/dev_bpw_twin_ref-0026.py babylm/eval/dev_bpw_twin.py; mkdir -p babylm/moonshot; [ -f babylm/moonshot/__init__.py ] || touch babylm/moonshot/__init__.py; gsutil -q cp __BUCKET__/code/dev_bpw_dump_ref-0034.py babylm/moonshot/dev_bpw_dump.py; echo  | base64 -d > babylm/configs/jobs_dw_r0.json; echo 'cd56b7076b17823c735d4b499eb8022f2e257305c4d02ca567d12f47bb1d7957  babylm/configs/jobs_dw_r0.json' | sha256sum -c -
note: Rung 0 stage 3 (one VM): LR (lr_scale 1.0) at W*, then pick s1/s2, then C s1/s2. Env W_STAR + W_STAR_TWIN filled at launch from stage-1 twins. maxdur 4h. | s3lr: LR cell alone at W*=wd0p8 (argmin s0 cal_t over W, critic 08:12Z); pick + kill check done locally on cal_t.

jobs.name: dw0_LR_s0
jobs.cmd: R=dw0_LR_${W_STAR}_s0; /opt/p2venv/bin/python -m babylm.harness.run_jobs babylm/configs/jobs_dw_r0.json --only $R; rc=$?; /opt/p2venv/bin/python -m babylm.analysis.post_runs --pt_runs $R; [ -f babylm/runs/$R/result.json ] && { bash babylm/harness/score_trial.sh babylm/runs/$R /opt/babylm || echo '[dw] score $R failed'; /opt/babylm/venv/bin/python babylm/eval/dev_bpw_twin.py babylm/runs/$R/score/hf /opt/babylm/osf/text_data/dev/dev --slice full --ws collapse --line_join newline --out babylm/runs/$R/score/dev_bpw_twin.json > babylm/runs/$R/score/dev_bpw_twin.log 2>&1 || echo '[twin] $R failed'; mkdir -p babylm/runs/$R/pt_v2; /opt/babylm/venv/bin/python -m babylm.moonshot.dev_bpw_dump babylm/runs/$R/score/hf /opt/babylm/osf/text_data/dev/dev --ws collapse --line_join newline --twin --temps 0.9,0.95,1.05,1.1,1.15,1.2 --out babylm/runs/$R/pt_v2/dev_v2.npz --check babylm/runs/$R/score/dev_bpw_twin.json > babylm/runs/$R/pt_v2/dump.log 2>&1 || echo '[ptv2] $R failed'; /opt/p2venv/bin/python -m babylm.harness.plot_curves babylm/runs/$R || true; }; exit $rc
